# An AI assistant that guides users inside your product

Aven works inside the applications you build. It answers contextual questions, identifies developer-registered pages and workflows, and lets your host application navigate and guide people to registered UI targets.

## Developer-declared context

Aven uses pages, elements, and workflows your team explicitly registers. The host application stays in control of navigation and UI behavior.
